event: US PPI on Fri 13 Nov, likely 15:30 SAST (date from one source, time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Asian bounce
bullets.text: Gold was 4,056.20 at 07:27 SAST, up 24.40 (+0.61%), with a range of 4,025.80 to 4,059.30 today (Kitco).

bullets.title: Back above 4,053
bullets.text: Price has climbed back over Monday's 4,053 low, but it is still below Tuesday's pre-CPI area of 4,068-4,072.

bullets.title: Hot CPI backdrop
bullets.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m against 0.3% expected and core rose 0.3% against 0.2%, which dragged gold down about 2.6% on Tuesday (TradingKey).

bullets.title: Hike bets high
bullets.text: Trading Economics puts December hike odds near 91%, and TradingKey says a 25bp hike is fully priced, with about 10% odds of 50bp.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 102.24 and the US 10-year yield near 4.99%, both still high and a weight on gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Fed speakers hawkish
bullets.text: Fed Governor Waller and Dallas Fed President Logan have sounded hawkish, so their comments can cap rallies (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: PPI next
bullets.text: US producer prices on Friday can add to or ease the hike talk (date from one source, UNVERIFIED).
